newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shortcovering seen for RSS1 in Singapore rubber.
newsitem.headline: Shortcovering seen for RSS1 in Singapore rubber.

text.p: The Singapore rubber market was hit on Friday by shortcovering for RSS1 rubber while Bridgestone was said to be still looking at prices for TSR20 rubber, dealers said.
"Some Malaysians were engaged in shortcovering for RSS1 rubber. They came in especially during the ring session," one trader said.
"I think in the last few days, Bridgestone bought a lot of TSR20, but I don't think I saw them pick up material this afternoon," another dealer said.
"They're (Bridgestone) are still there. They were still looking for a small consignment of TSR20 rubber, but I don't think any deals were done," another dealer said.
Traders said activity in the market was a bit thin ahead of the seasonally slow summer holiday season by major consumers like the U.S. and Europe.

At 0945 GMT, August RSS3 was seen at 108.00 U.S. cents a kg from 109.25 cents. August RSS1 was seen at 153.00 Singapore cents (US$1.07) a kg from 155.75 cents. October/December TSR20 was seen at 105.25 U.S. cents a kg from 105.50 cents.
